name: Barchino

verifiedBusinessInfo.address: 502 Washington Boulevard, Jersey City, NJ 07310 (Apple Maps, Yelp); NOTE the official site reportedly lists 506 Washington Blvd
verifiedBusinessInfo.other: Pre-opening pizza-focused sister restaurant to Battello, next door on the Newport waterfront; chef/partner Ryan DePersio (also Battello, Ember & Eagle, The Kitchen Step); 120 seats; casual and approachable, moderate prices; planned pizzas (crispy, artisan-style, fresh seasonal toppings), paninis, shared plates, salads, appetizers, wine; events space; reservations and private events 'opening soon'; originally targeted fall 2026, latest report (Hoboken Girl, Nov 2026) early December 2026. Email info@barchinojc.com.

designDirection: A Riviera boat-club announcement card for a pre-opening waterfront pizzeria (barchino is Italian for a little boat; its sister is Battello): Bodoni Moda high-contrast italics with Jost body, on marine navy, sail white, tomato red, sea glass, sand and basil. The hero hangs under a striped scalloped awning: a huge italic Barchino wordmark beside a bobbing porthole-framed margherita, over a notched boarding-pass strip (Port, Berth, Seats, Galley, Status). Below: planned menu categories as a column of CSS-drawn nautical signal flags with paired arch/rounded pizza photos, a navy 'crew' section with a facts manifest, a sand-colored opening log with a dotted route and a pulsing 'next' marker, and a sea-glass 'drop anchor' card with map buttons and contact rows. Single page because the restaurant has not published a menu yet. Primary CTA: follow on Instagram / directions.
